tests.name: Real turtlesim: visible topic but no reliable delivery
Live best_effort delivery and single-topic MCAP
Same MCAP replay with best_effort override

defect.reproducer: With record=false and subscriber_reliability=reliable, /robot_a/sensor_pose was visible but reliable echo timed out with exit 124; ROS logged incompatible QoS RELIABILITY.
defect.root_cause: The sensor publisher offers best_effort, which cannot satisfy a reliable subscription request.
defect.proof_after: With subscriber_reliability=best_effort the live echo and listener received Pose; one MCAP stored 416 Pose messages; replay of that same MCAP with best_effort override again delivered Pose while reliable echo timed out.
